label: Live: WebSocket Echo
description: Demo node for a WebSocket live connection driven through the ctx. Holds a two-way conversation: echoes each message the caller sends, with a turn counter, until they close. Wire under a Socket trigger.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The path the caller opened, off the Socket trigger; what starts this node.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: Fires true once the conversation ends (caller closed or went idle).
